description: Map a tiny codebase with no .planning/: single-shot mode (one agent) must produce the codebase documents.
why: Reality check RC20/R17 and RC7: the README once said 'six parallel agents'; the command runs single-shot below the sharding threshold. This seed is far below it, so exactly the single-shot path is exercised and its output — .planning/codebase/*.md — is the assertion.

steps.why: map-codebase.md: output is .planning/codebase/ with structured documents about the codebase.
